requirements.title: License number displayed in website advertising
requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7030.5

criteria: Website advertises construction/electrical contracting services in California (pacificplainselectric.com).
Also applies to Volteira-hosted contractor pages/booking pages that advertise a tenant's services.

required_behavior: The contractor's CSLB license number appears in all forms of advertising, including the website.

How to check: (1) the license number (digits, typically labelled 'CSLB Lic. #' or 'CA Lic. #') is visible on the homepage and in the footer of every page template, and on paid/landing pages and booking pages; (2) the number is real text (not only in an image) so it can be read and searched; (3) the same number appears on linked profiles the site controls (Google Business Profile, Yelp, social pages) as a best practice; (4) the number matches the CSLB record for the advertised business name (see WEB-CSLB-002).
requirements.enforcement_exposure: Citation and civil penalty by CSLB; failure is a cause for disciplinary action.
required_evidence: screenshot of license number on homepage and footer
crawl report listing pages missing the number

requirements.title: License active and advertised business name matches CSLB record
requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7059.1; 7028 (unlicensed contracting); 7027.1

criteria: Website advertises construction/electrical contracting services in California (pacificplainselectric.com).
Also applies to Volteira-hosted contractor pages/booking pages that advertise a tenant's services.

required_behavior: The license shown is current and active on the CSLB public license lookup on the audit date (not expired, suspended or inactive).
The business name used on the site (and in ads) is the name on the CSLB license record (or an approved DBA on the record); the site does not advertise under a different or misleading name.

How to check: search the number at the CSLB Check a License page, record status, legal name/DBA, entity type, classifications, bond and workers' compensation status, and compare with site header, footer, About page and legal pages.
requirements.enforcement_exposure: Advertising without a valid license or under an unregistered name: CSLB citation, civil penalties; unlicensed contracting is a misdemeanor (7028).

requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7059, 7117.6; 16 CCR 832.10 (C-10 Electrical)

requirements.title: 'Licensed, bonded and insured' claims accurate
requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7071.6 (contractor bond), 7125 (workers' compensation), 7071.19 (LLC liability insurance), 7161(a)

criteria: Website advertises construction/electrical contracting services in California (pacificplainselectric.com).
Also applies to Volteira-hosted contractor pages/booking pages that advertise a tenant's services.

required_behavior: 'Bonded' matches an active contractor's bond on the CSLB record (B&P 7071.6 requires a $25,000 contractor's bond); 'insured' is backed by current liability insurance (for an LLC licensee, the policy required by 7071.19: aggregate limit not less than $1,000,000 with five or fewer persons on the personnel of record, plus $100,000 for each additional person, up to $5,000,000); and the workers' compensation status on the CSLB record is current (a certificate of workers' compensation insurance or self-insurance, or, under the 7125 in force until January 1, 2028, a filed no-employee exemption, which is unavailable to C-8, C-20, C-22, C-39 and D-49 licensees; from January 1, 2028 only joint ventures with no employees are exempt).
Claims are removed promptly if a bond, policy or license lapses.
requirements.enforcement_exposure: Misleading representations are grounds for discipline (7161) and FAL/UCL claims.
required_evidence: CSLB record bond and WC section

requirements.title: No misleading inducements or 'free' offers
requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7161

criteria: Website advertises construction/electrical contracting services in California (pacificplainselectric.com).
Also applies to Volteira-hosted contractor pages/booking pages that advertise a tenant's services.

required_behavior: The site does not use false, misleading, or deceptive advertising as an inducement to enter into a contract for a work of improvement (B&P 7161(a)), does not make substantial misrepresentations or false promises likely to induce a person to contract (7161(b)), and does not publish advertising containing a false, deceptive or misleading statement of fact or advertise work with the intent not to accept contracts for it or at the advertised price (7161(e)); any 'free' goods or services, prizes or discounts offered as inducements are therefore truthful, with their conditions stated (7161 has no separate rule on 'free' offers; an advertisement that complies with FTC rules, regulations or guides is not deemed false, deceptive or misleading under 7161(e)).

requirements.title: Online home improvement contract contains statutory contents
requirements.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code 7159(c)-(e)
requirements.amendment_notes: AB 1327 (Stats. 2025) added contractor email/telephone and email Notice of Cancellation provisions (per secondary sources and CSLB 2026 new-laws bulletin); not verified against official text.

criteria: A home improvement contract (work on residential property, aggregate contract price over the statutory threshold, $500 under B&P 7159 per prior knowledge — confirm current threshold) is formed, signed or accepted online (e-signature, click-to-accept estimate, or online deposit that accepts an estimate).
business_types: pacificplainselectric.com and any Volteira-hosted estimate/contract acceptance page used by Pacific Plains Electric
exceptions: Service and repair contracts meeting B&P 7159.10 et seq. have separate, alternative requirements (see WEB-CSLB-016).
Commercial (non-residential) work is outside 7159.

required_behavior: The e-signed or click-accepted contract includes the 7159 contents in substantially the statutory form: legible writing and readable print with text in at least 10-point type and headings in at least 10-point boldface (7159(c)(1)-(2)); on the first page, the date the buyer signed and the name, address and email address of the contractor to whom the "Notice of Cancellation" is to be sent, immediately preceded by a statement that the notice may be sent to the contractor at the address or email address noted on the contract, plus the contractor's telephone number for help with the notice (7159(c)(3)(B)); the lien-release statement (7159(c)(4)); an incorporated change-order form (7159(c)(5)); the performance-and-payment-bond notice in close proximity to the signatures (7159(c)(6)); the subcontractor Yes/No statement and disclaimer (7159(c)(7)); the contractor's name, business address and license number (7159(d)(1)); the home improvement salesperson's name and registration number if applicable (7159(d)(2)); the heading "Home Improvement" in at least 10-point boldface (7159(d)(3)); the 12-point boldface statement "You are entitled to a completely filled in copy of this agreement, signed by both you and the contractor, before any work may be started." (7159(d)(4)); "Contract Price" and, if charged, "Finance Charge" (7159(d)(5)-(6)); "Description of the Project and Description of the Significant Materials to be Used and Equipment to be Installed" (7159(d)(7)); "Downpayment" with the 12-point boldface notice "THE DOWNPAYMENT MAY NOT EXCEED $1,000 OR 10 PERCENT OF THE CONTRACT PRICE, WHICHEVER IS LESS." (7159(d)(8)); "Schedule of Progress Payments" with its statement (7159(d)(9)); a statement of what constitutes substantial commencement of work, "Approximate Start Date" and "Approximate Completion Date" (7159(d)(10)-(11)); if applicable, "List of Documents to be Incorporated into the Contract" (7159(d)(12)); "Note About Extra Work and Change Orders" with its statement (7159(d)(13)); and the notices on commercial general liability insurance, workers' compensation insurance and extra/change-order work, the "Mechanics Lien Warning", the CSLB information notice, and the applicable right-to-cancel notice with the "Notice of Cancellation" form (7159(e)(1)-(7)). (Bonded contractors under 7159.5(a)(8) may omit the downpayment statement, progress-payment details and Mechanics Lien Warning.)
Contract is presented in full to the buyer before signature (not only a summary).
requirements.enforcement_exposure: Noncompliant contracts: CSLB discipline, misdemeanor exposure under 7159, and potential unenforceability/restitution claims.
required_evidence: copy of the online contract template

requirements.title: Online down payment/deposit within statutory limit

criteria: A home improvement contract (work on residential property, aggregate contract price over the statutory threshold, $500 under B&P 7159 per prior knowledge — confirm current threshold) is formed, signed or accepted online (e-signature, click-to-accept estimate, or online deposit that accepts an estimate).

requirements.title: Magnuson-Moss: written warranty terms available before sale online

criteria: Site sells (or quotes for sale) consumer products costing more than $15 with a written warranty, including products sold online.

required_behavior: For consumer products actually costing the consumer more than $15.00 that are sold with a written warranty through the website (an offer whose ordering instructions do not require a personal visit is a 'catalog or mail order sale', 16 CFR 702.3(c)(1)(i)), the site clearly and conspicuously discloses, in close conjunction to the product description (or in a clearly referenced information section), either the full text of the written warranty or the warrantor's website address where the terms can be reviewed together with a statement that the written warranty can be obtained free upon specific request and the address or phone number for requesting it (702.3(c)(2)); for sales negotiated in the customer's home, the representative discloses before the sale, orally and in written materials, that copies of the warranties are available for inspection (702.3(d)).
required_evidence: screenshot of warranty link near product/offer
